opportunities.name: Spirit transfer health bruiser
opportunities.objective: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Test of Spirit echoes a fraction of spirit damage with a 0.0008 AD expression; Harsh Lesson has AD-linked percent-health physical damage and directs nearby tentacle slams. Bloodmail converts health to AD, Cleaver supports physical hits, and Visage enhances tentacle missing-health heals. Sundered Sky is reserved for Illaoi's actual attack, with spirit classification deliberately unproved.
opportunities.requiredState: Need E connected, usable terrain tentacles and enemies remaining near the spirit.
opportunities.failure: Kiting or destroying tentacles denies the loop; spirit transfer cannot replace direct target access forever.
opportunities.test: Compare owner health lost with spirit-only damage versus owner-plus-spirit overlap, logging individual hits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Spirit damage and echoed damage are not automatically two independent item procs against the owner.

opportunities.name: Ultimate lesson clock
opportunities.objective: Test more attack-and-slam cycles inside Leap of Faith.
opportunities.mechanic: Leap of Faith grants an eight-second window where tentacles slam 50% faster and W cooldown changes. Trinity adds one physical Spellblade to a real W attack; Blade rewards direct attacks and Shojin raises ability/passive damage after qualifying hits. The aim is repeated directed slams rather than expecting attack speed to make tentacles independently attack faster.
opportunities.requiredState: Need R hitting multiple champions, tentacles placed and W targets in range.
opportunities.failure: Enemies disengage during R, or mana runs out; offensive purchases expose Illaoi before setup.
opportunities.test: Count W casts and actual tentacle slams within eight seconds at identical terrain placement.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Attack speed does not directly reduce the tentacles' autonomous spirit/marked-target timer.

ruledOut.reason: Tentacle slam tooltips do not establish inheritance of Blade or Trinity attack procs.

unknowns: Tentacle damage expression and R W-cooldown token are unresolved; spirit item/rune target classification needs live logs.

builds.name: Spirit transfer health bruiser
builds.summary: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
builds.goal: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
builds.hypothesis: Test of Spirit echoes a fraction of spirit damage with a 0.0008 AD expression; Harsh Lesson has AD-linked percent-health physical damage and directs nearby tentacle slams. Bloodmail converts health to AD, Cleaver supports physical hits, and Visage enhances tentacle missing-health heals. Sundered Sky is reserved for Illaoi's actual attack, with spirit classification deliberately unproved.
testPlan: Required state: Need E connected, usable terrain tentacles and enemies remaining near the spirit.
Compare owner health lost with spirit-only damage versus owner-plus-spirit overlap, logging individual hits.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting or destroying tentacles denies the loop; spirit transfer cannot replace direct target access forever.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Spirit damage and echoed damage are not automatically two independent item procs against the owner.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for [7] seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with [0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0008) × AD] of that damage echoing to its owner.

If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for [4] seconds and is Slowed by [80]% for [1.5] seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible.

Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby ([characterLevelInterpolation(18 → 7; raw flags preserved)] second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities.

Slam deals @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores [5]% missing Health to Illaoi.

Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional [(3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5 + (0.035) × AD) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.

Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit.

For the next [8] seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a @spell.IllaoiW:CooldownDuringR@ second cooldown.
